subject: Request: Starter incentive + trial extension — exec sign-off needed
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@peerlytics.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peerlytics Sales Ops <salesops@peerlytics.io>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: trial extension + starter credits to finalize POC

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Peerlytics is excited about Redwood's latency and observability. We have a pilot lined up with two internal teams. Before we can sign off on the POC, procurement is asking for two concessions to hit their approval window:

- Extend the proof-of-value from 30 to 60 days
- Provide $25k in starter credits (to cover model usage spikes during data onboarding)

I know those are material asks, which is why I'm reaching out early — if we can get approval this week we can move our internal kickoff to Oct 6. I attached our Q3 usage forecast for context.

Can you let me know if Redwood can support that structure (or what a compromise looks like)?

Best,
Evan
Director of Product
Peerlytics

Attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv (CSV, 52KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@peerlytics.io>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: trial extension + starter credits to finalize POC

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Appreciate the timeline pressure. High-level: we can usually do either a trial extension or credits on the hosted plan without escalation, but both together at $25k would need executive sign-off.

Proposed near-term compromise (I can confirm with my manager):
- 45-day extension (instead of 60)
- $7,500 starter credit applied to hosted usage

If Peerlytics can commit to a pilot activation milestone (two teams onboarded and a short SOW to convert to a pilot purchase order within 30 days of pilot completion), I can escalate for an additional credits top-up. Please confirm whether the activation milestone is something you can commit to.

I'll loop in Marissa for a quick decision if you confirm.

Thanks,
Mina
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: trial extension + starter credits to finalize POC

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Evan's request (summary below). Need exec guidance: Peerlytics is a mid-market analytics company. They want a 60-day extension + $25k credits. Forecast attached shows likely usage burst during onboarding, but ARR expectation is modest (~$120k ARR first year if pilot converts).

My recommendation: approve a conditional package we can sign off quickly to keep momentum: 45-day extension + $10k credits, contingent on a pilot activation milestone (two teams onboarded within first 30 days). If we approve, we should add a clause that credits expire at end of extended trial and aren't transferrable.

Why lower than asked: $25k is outside standard starter concessions for this segment; we should protect unit economics. If you want, I can mark as an exception request to apply a one-time 15% discount on year-one committed pricing if they sign within 60 days of pilot completion.

Attachments: usage_report_Q3.csv

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-29T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask: trial extension + starter credits to finalize POC

Thanks Mina — good summary. Approve the conditional concession with the following firm boundaries:

- 45-day extension on the hosted trial (no change to standard SLA)
- $10,000 starter credit applied to usage during the extended trial window
- One-time 15% discount on year-one committed pricing only if they sign a minimum $100k ARR contract within 60 days after pilot close
- Credits expire at the end of the extended trial and do not roll over; accounting to mark as promotional credit under DL-2026-0491

Please include the language below in the confirmation email to the customer and send the updated MSA draft to legal for the 15% promo clause. I'll approve the credit from the promo budget.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--- internal note: approved per Marissa (promo budget). Mark deal DL-2026-0491 in HubSpot and flag revenue ops for the credit ledger.

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@peerlytics.io>
Cc: Peerlytics Sales Ops <salesops@peerlytics.io>
Date: 2026-09-29T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: trial extension + starter credits to finalize POC

Hi Evan — good news. Marissa signed off on a conditional package to keep momentum:

- 45-day extension to the hosted trial (new end date: Nov 10, 2026)
- $10,000 starter credit applied to usage during the extended trial
- One-time 15% discount on year-one committed pricing if Peerlytics signs ≥ $100k ARR within 60 days of pilot close

Conditions: credits expire at the end of the extended trial and are applied only to usage (not to future invoices); credits will be documented under Deal ID DL-2026-0491. Please confirm you accept the conditions and the activation milestone (two teams onboarded within first 30 days of the extension). Once you confirm, I'll send an updated MSA draft and DocuSign link for the promo clause and set the credits in our billing system.

Thanks!
Mina
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: peerlytics_msa_draft.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Evan Brooks <evan@peerlytics.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: trial extension + starter credits to finalize POC

Mina — that works for us. We accept the 45-day extension and the $10k credit with the activation milestone. We'll aim to onboard the two teams within the first 30 days and target the $100k ARR threshold for year-one.

Please send the DocuSign link and the updated MSA and we'll get procurement moving. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Evan
Director of Product
Peerlytics

Attachment: peerlytics_signed_po_stub.pdf (PDF stub)
